facts.fact: Wavemaker's document-to-video pipeline storyboards a video across one of 21 presets.
facts.quote: storyboards it across one of 21 presets

facts.fact: According to Wavemaker, most document-to-video outputs are produced in two to five minutes.
facts.quote: Most videos land in two to five minutes.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free tier exports videos at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: The free tier exports at 480p with a watermark, which is plenty for a first test.

facts.fact: Wavemaker allows export up to 4K resolution on paid plans.
facts.quote: Export up to 4K on paid plans.

facts.fact: Wavemaker states that a summary video generated from a research report or data brief hits the top takeaways in 30-60 seconds.
facts.quote: A summary video that hits the top takeaways in 30-60 seconds

facts.fact: Per Wyzowl's 2024 State of Video Marketing survey (third-party), 89% of consumers said watching a video convinced them to buy a product or service.
facts.quote: In Wyzowl's 2024 survey, 89% of consumers said watching a video convinced them to buy a product or service

facts.fact: Per Wyzowl's 2024 State of Video Marketing survey (third-party), 91% of businesses reported using video as a marketing tool.
facts.quote: 91% of businesses reported using video as a marketing tool (Wyzowl, State of Video Marketing 2024)

facts.fact: Wavemaker's document input accepts PDFs, documents, and notes as uploadable text sources.
facts.quote: The input handles PDFs, documents, and notes, which covers most of what people have sitting in a folder.

facts.fact: Wavemaker suggests 16:9 aspect ratio for YouTube and the web, 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, and 1:1 or 4:5 for feed posts.
facts.quote: 16:9 for YouTube and the web, 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, 1:1 or 4:5 for feed posts

facts.fact: Adwave states that a finished 30-second video can run as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks starting from $50.
facts.quote: the same 30-second video can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks, from $50, alongside Google, YouTube, Meta, Reddit, and display.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan includes 75 credits, enough for the first video, with a 480p export and a watermark.
facts.quote: The free plan gives you 75 credits, enough for your first video, with a 480p export and a watermark.

facts.fact: Wavemaker paid plans start at $29 per month for up to 1080p resolution, no watermark, and more credits, with up to 4K on higher tiers.
facts.quote: Paid plans start at $29/mo for higher resolution (up to 1080p), no watermark, and more credits, with up to 4K on higher tiers.

facts.fact: Adwave's TV commercial offering is available on 100+ premium streaming networks.
facts.quote: can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks, from $50

facts.fact: Pictory and Lumen5 are described by Adwave as pairing script text with stock footage matched by keywords, rather than generating custom visuals.
facts.quote: Tools like Pictory and Lumen5 take your text and pair it with stock footage, matching keywords in your script to clips in a library.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's document input accepts PDFs, documents, and notes, including reports, whitepapers, slide decks, meeting notes, articles, and study material.
facts.quote: Wavemaker's document input handles PDFs, documents, and notes, which covers reports, whitepapers, slide decks, meeting notes, articles, and study material.

facts.fact: Wavemaker states there is no hard rule on source document length, and focused documents produce sharper videos.
facts.quote: There's no hard rule, but focused documents produce sharper videos.

facts.fact: Wavemaker video refinement is done via natural-language chat and does not require a timeline, with a refine pass costing far less than a full generation.
facts.quote: There's no timeline and no clips to drag around, and a refine pass costs far less than a full generation.
